thread:
incident-bot: Pager: high 5xx rate (gateway/timeout) for hosted-api eu-west-1. Alert threshold breached: 5xx >= 8% over 5m. Links: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/1778804321 :rotating_light:

emma_ops: i'm on mobile, grabbing laptop. any immediate customer pings?

eli_support: getting a handful of emails — 3 customers reporting timeouts in the last 4m (acme-inc, tinychat, docflow). forwarding details to #support-escalations.

raj_oncall: taking pager. first check: is this region-wide or model-specific?

sophia_sre: dashboards show broad 502/504 spike across frontend gateway + rate limiter error surge (429s) upstream. looks like a config push to the quota service ~8m ago — propagated policies to eu-west shards. check kms-config-rollout?

emma_ops: deploy-bot shows a config commit at 1778800000 by nate_eng for quota/enforcement: "tighten-default-tenant-policy". Nate, do you see this?
\

nate_eng: yep i pushed that change to tighten burst windows — intended to target a small tenant group. the rollout was flagged for staged rollout but apparently targeted the wrong tag. investigating now.

raj_oncall: ok probable cause candidate: mis-scoped quota roll, causing many tenants to hit 429 -> clients retry -> overload gateway -> 5xx. mitigation steps: 1) stop rollout / revert config 2) enable permissive fallback in gateway 3) rate limiter bypass for hosted-api for 10m 4) scale gateway replicas. doing step 1 now.

emma_ops: how do we revert? deploy-bot:?

deploy-bot: Revert request received for commit nate_eng@1778799996. Starting rollback pipeline. CI checks passed. ETA ~2m.

sophia_sre: while rollback running, add temporary traffic steering: route traffic for high-volume tenants to dedicated-serving pool (if capacity) to reduce pressure on shared gateway. raj, can you run the routing command?

raj_oncall: running:

```
# add route for tenant prefixes
curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/route -d '{"prefix":"acme-*","target":"dedicated-eu-west-1","priority":10}'
```

Response: 202 accepted. steering applied for top 20 tenants.

eli_support: ping from acme-inc — they confirm reduced errors for some requests. still seeing a few timeouts for large-batch calls.

nate_eng: rollback finished. deploy-bot: revert applied, ring 0/3 success, full rollback completed at 1778804480.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed. Post-deploy check: gateway error rate dropped from 12% -> 4% over 90s.

emma_ops: nice. now step 2/3: temporarily disable strict quota enforcement while we validate. raj, can you flip permissive mode on rl-service?

raj_oncall: flipping permissive=true on rl-service (eu-west-1) via feature toggle: `curl -X POST https://flags.internal/rl-service -d '{"eu-west-1": {"enforcement": "permissive"}}'` -> 200 OK.

sophia_sre: confirm metrics: 429s dropped to 0.8% and 5xxs trending down to 1.6%. latency stabilizing. still seeing a few 504s from long-tailing requests. might be retries from clients. recommend adding short-term retry-jitter guidance to clients, but that's customer-facing.

eli_support: drafting a controlled customer note: "We're investigating intermittent timeouts in EU. We've applied mitigations and are monitoring. We'll follow up with timeline and RCA." Want to coordinate wording?

emma_ops: keep it short: acknowledge, say mitigations applied, and ETA for more updates 30m.

raj_oncall: scaling gateway preemptively: `kubectl scale deploy gateway-eu --replicas=8 -n prod` -> scaled. Also increased connection pool limits on nginx.

nate_eng: looked through logs — rate limiter returned 429 with header X-Quota-Rule: default-tight-burst. That rule was supposed to be scoped to test tenants only. root cause: selector tag mismatch during rollout. adding issue for rollout target checks.

sophia_sre: add runbook note: verify rollout targeting uses tag 'canary-tenant' not 'tenant-*'.

raj_oncall: monitoring thread: watch 5xx, 429, p95 latency. setting slack alert to lower threshold for next 60m.

incident-bot: Incident severity: Sev2. Pager silenced. Next actions: postmortem, impacted tenants list, timeline, mitigations, and follow-up owners.

eli_support: customer impact estimate: Acme-inc: intermittent timeouts 17:23–17:31 UTC, estimated 3% of their calls failed; TinyChat: 17:25–17:35 UTC, ~8% failure on heavy batch endpoints; Docflow: shorter window 17:27–17:30, ~10% failures. Will compile logs and SLAs.

emma_ops: good. raj, can you collect `kubectl logs` for gateway and rl-service for the window 1778804200–1778804700 and upload to /incidents/1778804321/artifacts ?

raj_oncall: done. uploaded tarball /incidents/1778804321/gateway_rl_logs.tgz (s3://internal/incidents/1778804321/gateway_rl_logs.tgz). also exported prometheus snapshots.

nate_eng: opened PR to add rollout safety checks and a preflight test for selector correctness: https://git.redwood/pull/5234. assigning to sophia for review.

sophia_sre: will review. also want a new test in canary pipelines to run a synthetic high-concurrency scenario for quota changes.

eli_support: sending initial customer notice now. will include: what happened, who affected, what we did, and next update in 2 hours with RCA.

emma_ops: action items captured: (1) postmortem owner: sophia_sre (2) rollout safety PR (nate_eng) (3) runbook update + test (raj_oncall) (4) customer RCA & timeline (eli_support).

raj_oncall: switching pager to follow mode, monitoring for 30m. thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Thread closed for immediate mitigation. Please reopen if errors rise above 3% 5xx.
notes: Contains root message and chronological replies. No title field per agents.md.
